Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In step 11, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the limit was "10 games per year" based on the premise that developers could use two imprints to bypass the "5 games per year" rule. This is a factual error; while publishers like Konami did create subsidiary labels (e.g., Ultra Games) to bypass the limit, the official Nintendo policy limit itself remained 5 games per year per license/publisher. The question asks for "Nintendo's limit," which is the official policy of 5, not the workaround maximum of 10 that some developers achieved. The Planner accepted this workaround as the limit itself, leading to the wrong answer (10 instead of 5).
